items.source_name: NHC Tropical Weather Discussion (2205 UTC Oct 13)
items.summary: NHC's 2205 UTC Oct 13 Tropical Weather Discussion shows a significant forecast shift for Hurricane Simon (still Cat 1, 90 mph/977 mb, ~20.2N 107.5W at 2100 UTC): Simon is expected to drift south to southwest over the next 24-36 hours, then begin a northward motion after 48 hours, approaching the coast of western Mexico this weekend rather than midweek. NHC forecast positions put Simon near Baja California Sur on Saturday afternoon (near 24.4N 110.2W) and then inland near 28.8N 111.1W in Sonora by Sunday afternoon - a move away from the earlier midweek Mazatlan/Sinaloa landfall scenario. NHC notes 'changes to watches and warnings could be required tonight or Wed based on the latest forecast trends' and tells interests in west-central Mexico and Baja California Sur to closely monitor forecast updates. Life-threatening flooding/mudslides and dangerous surf remain the key hazards.
items.title: Simon forecast shifts: weekend coast approach, possible Sunday inland crossing over Sonora
